example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কপাল দোষ, সব কাজেই ব্যর্থ হয়ে যায়।
এটা আমার কপাল দোষ, না হলে এমন হত না।
example_sentences_in_english: It's his bad luck that he fails in every endeavor.
This is due to my adverse fate; otherwise, it wouldn't have happened.
note: Rooted in the cultural belief that one's forehead bears the mark of destiny in Bengali folklore.
